description:
Communities competing for Seedit's /s/videos route. The highest-rated finalized candidate resolves the route. Subscriptions and post links continue to use exact community addresses.

https://github.com/bitsocialnet/lists/blob/master/seedit-directories/seedit-videos-directory.json
rules: Link directly to one video, not an embed-only page, shortened URL, playlist, or channel page.
Do not post personal information, encourage witch-hunts, or direct harassment toward anyone shown.
No pornography, gore, death footage, malicious assaults, or abuse of people or animals.
Do not solicit votes, views, followers, giveaways, donations, or fundraising support.
No hate speech, threats, or demeaning attacks on people or groups.
Do not submit third-party licensing bait, watermarked agency content, or self-promotional channel material.
